description: 8 independent on/off switches in one package; switch N's two contacts are `Na`/`Nb`.
how_to_use: Each switch's two contacts (e.g. `1a`/`1b`) are only the same net while that specific switch is toggled on — unlike a pushbutton's paired legs, they're genuinely two separate terminals, not two names for one node. Within a given switch, `Na`/`Nb` are freely interchangeable (a plain on/off contact doesn't care about direction), so they're marked symmetric.

plain.what: Eight tiny on/off switches in one block — for settings you rarely change.
plain.how: Flip each switch with a pen tip. Each switch joins its own pair of legs when it's ON.
